"""Pre-evaluation CPU FP32 diagnostics; fixed atol1e-6, not GPU qualification."""
import json, math, sys
import numpy as np

A=[.254829592,-.284496736,1.421413741,-1.453152027,1.061405429]
P=.3275911
INV_SQRT2=1/math.sqrt(2)
BITS=np.arange(65536,dtype=np.uint16)
X=BITS.view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
FINITE=np.isfinite(X);BITS=BITS[FINITE];X=X[FINITE]
REF=np.array([0.5*float(v)*math.erfc(-float(v)/math.sqrt(2)) for v in X],dtype=np.float64)
CONFIGS=[
 ('original',A,P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('coeff_6_decimal',[round(c,6) for c in A],P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('coeff_5_decimal',[round(c,5) for c in A],P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('coeff_4_decimal',[round(c,4) for c in A],P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('all_6_decimal',[round(c,6) for c in A],round(P,6),round(INV_SQRT2,6),None),
 ('all_5_decimal',[round(c,5) for c in A],round(P,5),round(INV_SQRT2,5),None),
 ('coeff_6_significant',[float(f'{c:.6g}') for c in A],P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('coeff_5_significant',[float(f'{c:.5g}') for c in A],P,INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('inv_sqrt2_5_decimal',A,P,round(INV_SQRT2,5),None),
 ('folded_denominator_full',A,P,INV_SQRT2,P*INV_SQRT2),
 ('folded_denominator_6_decimal',A,P,INV_SQRT2,round(P*INV_SQRT2,6)),
 ('folded_denominator_5_decimal',A,P,INV_SQRT2,round(P*INV_SQRT2,5)),
 ('inv_sqrt2_4_decimal',A,P,round(INV_SQRT2,4),None),
 ('p_4_decimal',A,round(P,4),INV_SQRT2,None),
 ('folded_denominator_4_decimal',A,P,INV_SQRT2,round(P*INV_SQRT2,4)),
 ('coeff_5_decimal_p_4_decimal',[round(c,5) for c in A],round(P,4),INV_SQRT2,None),
]

def forward(aa,p,inv_sqrt2,fold):
 magnitude=np.abs(X)
 if fold is None:
  u=magnitude*np.float32(inv_sqrt2)
  denominator=np.float32(1)+np.float32(p)*u
 else:denominator=np.float32(1)+np.float32(fold)*magnitude
 t=np.float32(1)/denominator
 polynomial=np.full_like(X,np.float32(aa[4]))
 for c in reversed(aa[:4]):polynomial=polynomial*t+np.float32(c)
 polynomial*=t
 envelope=np.exp(-(np.float32(.5)*(magnitude*magnitude)),dtype=np.float32)
 tail=np.float32(.5)*(polynomial*envelope)
 return X*np.where(X<0,tail,np.float32(1)-tail)

results=[]
for name,a,p,inv,fold in CONFIGS:
 output=forward(a,p,inv,fold);error=np.abs(output.astype(np.float64)-REF);i=int(error.argmax())
 results.append({'name':name,'coefficients':a,'p':p,'inv_sqrt2':inv,'folded_denominator_constant':fold,
  'elements':len(X),'failing_elements':int((error>1e-6).sum()),'max_abs_error':float(error[i]),'worst_input':float(X[i]),
  'worst_bits':hex(int(BITS[i])),'actual':float(output[i]),'reference':float(REF[i])})
record={'target':'mathematical GELU(x)=0.5*x*erfc(-x/sqrt2)','atol':1e-6,'rtol':0,'model':'CPU FP32 separate operations, np.exp, not GPU qualification',
 'python':sys.version,'numpy':np.__version__,'candidates':results}
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))

"""Pre-evaluation CPU FP32 SiLU diagnostics, fixed atol1e-6/rtol0.

All finite FP16 scalar encodings, stable exponential-tail decomposition,
separate FP32 operations. NumPy exp2 is not a model of all T4 exp2 details;
independent GPU qualification is required before assigning fixed labels.
"""
import json,math,sys
import numpy as np
ATOL=1e-6
LOG2E=1/math.log(2)
CONFIGS=[('full_log2e',LOG2E),('log2e_7_decimal',round(LOG2E,7)),
 ('log2e_6_decimal',round(LOG2E,6)),('log2e_5_decimal',round(LOG2E,5)),
 ('log2e_4_decimal',round(LOG2E,4)),('log2e_3_decimal',round(LOG2E,3))]
bits=np.arange(65536,dtype=np.uint16);x=bits.view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
finite=np.isfinite(x);x=x[finite];bits=bits[finite]
ref=[]
for v in x:
 a=abs(float(v));q=math.exp(-a);tail=a*q/(1+q)
 ref.append(float(v)-tail if v>=0 else -tail)
ref=np.array(ref,dtype=np.float64)
results=[]
for name,log2e in CONFIGS:
 a=np.abs(x);q=np.exp2(-(a*np.float32(log2e)),dtype=np.float32)
 tail=(a*q)/(np.float32(1)+q)
 out=np.where(x>=0,x-tail,-tail)
 err=np.abs(out.astype(np.float64)-ref);i=int(err.argmax())
 results.append({'name':name,'log2e':log2e,'fp32_log2e':float(np.float32(log2e)),
  'elements':len(x),'failing_elements':int((err>ATOL).sum()),'max_abs_error':float(err[i]),
  'worst_input':float(x[i]),'worst_bits':hex(int(bits[i])),'actual':float(out[i]),'reference':float(ref[i])})
print(json.dumps({'target':'SiLU(x)=x/(1+exp(-x))','atol':ATOL,'rtol':0,'python':sys.version,'numpy':np.__version__,
 'model':'CPU separate FP32 arithmetic with np.exp2; not GPU qualification','candidates':results},indent=2))

No API/GPU execution. Every tried candidate is retained in results.
FP32 arithmetic emulates explicit round-to-nearest operations; libSystem fmaf
implements the explicit fused multiply-add. GPU acceptance needs separate T4
qualification and the CPU reference below is diagnostic, not label authority.
"""
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

ATOL=1e-6
INV_HALF_PI=0.63661977236758134308
LOW_HALF_PI=0.00048382679489661923
CONFIGS=[{'name':'hi201_over128_fused','hi':201/128,'fused':True},
         {'name':'hi201_over128_separate','hi':201/128,'fused':False}]
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None)
fmaf=lib.fmaf
fmaf.argtypes=(ctypes.c_float,ctypes.c_float,ctypes.c_float)
fmaf.restype=ctypes.c_float

def fp32(v): return np.asarray(v,dtype=np.float32)
def mul(a,b): return fp32(fp32(a)*fp32(b))
def add(a,b): return fp32(fp32(a)+fp32(b))
def sub(a,b): return fp32(fp32(a)-fp32(b))
def fma(a,b,c):
    a,b,c=np.broadcast_arrays(fp32(a),fp32(b),fp32(c))
    return np.array([fmaf(float(aa),float(bb),float(cc)) for aa,bb,cc in zip(a.flat,b.flat,c.flat)],dtype=np.float32).reshape(a.shape)

def evaluate(x,config):
    q=fp32(np.floor(add(mul(x,INV_HALF_PI),.5)))
    r_hi=sub(x,mul(q,config['hi']))
    low=LOW_HALF_PI
    r=fma(-q,low,r_hi) if config['fused'] else sub(r_hi,mul(q,low))
    z=mul(r,r)
    sin_poly=add(mul(z,1/362880),-1/5040)
    sin_poly=add(mul(z,sin_poly),1/120)
    sin_poly=add(mul(z,sin_poly),-1/6)
    sine=add(r,mul(mul(r,z),sin_poly))
    cos_poly=add(mul(z,1/40320),-1/720)
    cos_poly=add(mul(z,cos_poly),1/24)
    cos_poly=add(mul(z,cos_poly),-.5)
    cosine=add(1,mul(z,cos_poly))
    quadrant=q.astype(np.int32)&3
    value=np.where((quadrant&1)==0,sine,cosine)
    value=np.where((quadrant&2)==0,value,-value).astype(np.float32)
    return value, q,r

def main():
    bits=np.arange(65536,dtype=np.uint16)
    half=bits.view(np.float16)
    finite=np.isfinite(half)
    bits=bits[finite]
    x=half[finite].astype(np.float32)
    ref=np.array([math.sin(float(v)) for v in x],dtype=np.float64)
    records=[]
    for config in CONFIGS:
        y,q,r=evaluate(x,config)
        error=np.abs(y.astype(np.float64)-ref)
        i=int(np.argmax(error)); ri=int(np.argmax(np.abs(r)))
        rec={**config,'atol':ATOL,'rtol':0,'n_finite_encodings':int(x.size),'cpu_pass':bool(np.all(error<=ATOL)),'n_over_tol':int(np.count_nonzero(error>ATOL)),'max_abs_error':float(error[i]),'worst':{'bits':f'0x{bits[i]:04x}','x':float(x[i]),'actual':float(y[i]),'reference_math_sin':float(ref[i]),'q':float(q[i]),'r':float(r[i])},'max_abs_reduced':float(np.abs(r[ri])),'max_reduced_at':float(x[ri]),'low_public_literal_binary64':float(LOW_HALF_PI),'low_fp32':float(np.float32(LOW_HALF_PI)),'max_q':float(np.max(np.abs(q))),'nonfinite_outputs':int(np.count_nonzero(~np.isfinite(y)))}
        records.append(rec)
    result={'contract_predeclared':{'target':'real sin on exact stored finite FP16 value','atol':ATOL,'rtol':0,'input':'all 63488 finite FP16 encodings, one dimensional N in [1,131072]','output':'fresh finite FP32, input preserved'},'search_kind':'pre-model CPU construction simulation, not independent qualification','environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'numpy':np.__version__,'platform':platform.platform(),'fma':'C fmaf from process/libSystem'},'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'candidates':records}
    out=Path('/private/tmp/kv-sine-results.json');out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
